messages.todo.empty.upcoming-text: Todos with a due date appear here by date.
messages.todo.empty.upcoming-title: Nothing due in the next 7 days
messages.todo.empty.waiting-text: Set a todo to “Waiting on others” and note who and what you are waiting for.

messages.todo.error.not-open: Todo did not open. Refresh and try again

messages.todo.field.planned-date-help: The day you plan to do it
messages.todo.field.remind-hint: You are reminded in the bottom bar when it is time, following your own reminder rules. Nothing arrives while Molis Work is closed; missed ones show when you open it.
messages.todo.link.title: Links
messages.todo.note.assistant-changed: The Assistant just changed this todo. You have unsaved input; saving will report the conflict instead of overwriting.

messages.todo.review.existing-same: Same as “{title}”; this source will be added to it
messages.todo.review.none-text: Ask the Assistant below to organize materials; the results wait here for you to decide.

messages.todo.review.reference-count: {count} more for reference only, not listed
messages.todo.section.sources: Source and why it is a todo
messages.todo.skill.todo-advance.description: Use when the user asks to move a specific todo forward. Identify the next step and blockers, create useful drafts, and propose status changes without applying them unasked.
messages.todo.skill.todo-advance.name: Advance a todo
messages.todo.skill.todo-advance.when-not-to-use: Do not use to extract new tasks from material; use Organize todos. Do not use merely to list todos or change their status.
messages.todo.skill.todo-advance.when-to-use: The user has a specific todo and wants help drafting messages, preparing questions, writing a brief, or arranging time and reminders.
messages.todo.skill.todo-organize.description: Use when the user wants tasks extracted from mail, files, meeting notes, web pages or current content, asks about missed tasks, or asks how an email changes existing plans. Present proposed tasks for confirmation first.
messages.todo.skill.todo-organize.name: Organize todos
messages.todo.skill.todo-organize.when-not-to-use: Do not use to advance an existing task; use Advance a todo. Do not use for simply recording, listing or changing the status of a todo.
messages.todo.skill.todo-organize.when-to-use: There is material to turn into tasks, recent incoming material to check for omissions, or an email whose effect on plans needs review.
messages.todo.source.title: Source

messages.todo.summary.unscheduled: {count} without a date; schedule them when you can
